test_case.purpose: Run the approved MLPerf Inference v5.0 RetinaNet workload in Offline scenario on the pinned SUT and compare its valid Samples/s result only with an approved like-for-like MLCommons v5.0 reference.
required_package: Exact MLPerf Inference v5.0 implementation/harness revision and configuration
RetinaNet model, weights, dataset/calibration assets, checksums and licenses
SUT software/hardware/power/thermal settings and exact run command
Comparable MLCommons system/result, metric, run mode, validity rules and acceptance tolerance
test_case.test_command: Validate the signed harness/model/data/config manifest, then execute exactly one authorized `make run RUN_ARGS="--benchmarks=retinanet --scenarios=offline"` (or owner-approved equivalent that preserves RetinaNet+Offline), collect full LoadGen accuracy/performance/validity logs and health telemetry, and compare Samples/s against the matched reference using the supplied acceptance ratio.
test_case.expected_result: A valid full-duration MLPerf Inference v5.0 RetinaNet Offline result is produced with required accuracy/compliance markers, no health abort, and the approved comparison calculation is within the owner-signed threshold.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the pinned RetinaNet/Offline identity, valid non-smoke run, accuracy/compliance evidence, healthy SUT, matched v5.0 reference and approved numeric tolerance. BERT, training_results, a short test run, exit zero alone, or a comparison without a threshold is FAIL/BLOCKED, never PASS.
safety_gate: Isolate workloads and verify cooling/power/storage capacity
Monitor GPU temperature/power/errors/throttling and host health with hard aborts
Run only verified local assets/command and preserve full output
Do not auto-retry failed/invalid/stressed runs or download/execute moving branches
expected_evidence: Exact command, full build/run/compliance/performance logs and validity markers
Synchronized GPU/host health and abort status
Matched reference, metric/tolerance calculation and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop on thermal/power/ECC/Xid/driver or validity failure, preserve all output, return changed performance settings and services to their captured baseline, and do not automatically retry an invalid or failed run.
